name: io.github.cachly-dev/mcp-server
title: cachly — Explain it once. Every AI knows it.
description: Keeps the rules, decisions and fixes you explain to your AI, for every session and tool. EU servers.

environmentVariables.name: CACHLY_JWT
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key (starts with cky_). Leave it empty and cachly opens a browser sign-in on first use; the free plan needs no card.

environmentVariables.name: CACHLY_BRAIN_INSTANCE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional Brain id. Leave it empty to use the Brain saved by setup.

environmentVariables.name: CACHLY_NO_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to turn off usage pings.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by your cachly API key (starts with cky_). Get one at https://cachly.dev/setup-ai
